text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Small XGBoost model of the physics core's median residual (observed minus the core's median, points of capacity), scored on the held-out year with ERA5 as the weather. Top: permutation importance. Bottom: partial dependence on direction (degrees), 100 m wind speed (m/s), and hour of day (UTC). 3 wind farms, 53 Tuesday runs, 3 seeds, July 2025 to June 2026.'
text.tspan: Small XGBoost model of the physics core's median residual (observed minus the core's median,
points of capacity), scored on the held-out year with ERA5 as the weather. Top: permutation
importance. Bottom: partial dependence on direction (degrees), 100 m wind speed (m/s), and hour
of day (UTC). 3 wind farms, 53 Tuesday runs, 3 seeds, July 2025 to June 2026.
